en.description: Turn a topic, product, or audience note into a shootable short-video script and storyboard frames. This short video script and storyboard workflow confirms who it is for and the selling point, writes the hook, spoken lines, and shot list, then renders one still per shot. Use it for product clips, creator series, and shop videos when you need the script and the frames before anyone films or animates.
en.summary: A shootable short-video script plus one storyboard still per shot.
en.title: Short Video Script and Storyboard

zh.description: 把选题、商品或受众做成能拍的短视频脚本与分镜，满足各种短视频脚本需求：先确认受众和卖点，再写开头、口播和镜头表，并为每个镜头出一张分镜。短视频脚本可以先只出文字，确认后再出画面。适合带货、创作者系列和门店短视频。
